atomic_primitives.evidence: config_push_queue write is single SQL INSERT (atomic per-row); status='pending'→'delivered' is single UPDATE WHERE pod_id+seq_num; ConfigAck round-trip is single WS frame; AppState.config_push_seq is AtomicU64 fetch_add (no read-modify-write race). Phase 177 substrate at 1fc92867 + this PR's set_billing_status callsite at billing_session_lifecycle.rs +88/-20.

ttl_sentinels.evidence: Not a sentinel-class surface — no MAINTENANCE_MODE/OTA_DEPLOYING-class semaphore involved. config_push_queue rows persist until acked (or replayed on reconnect via CP-02). Watchdog-mutex orthogonal to this substrate.

behavioral_verify.evidence: Phase 177 substrate has DB row state machine (pending→delivered) + ConfigAck round-trip (agent→server with sequence + accepted flag) + config_audit_log row per push. Not echo-string — actual state change persisted to DB. PR #54 callsite uses these primitives correctly: INSERT (line +213 set_billing_status), UPDATE on Ok (line +247 set_billing_status), INSERT audit_log (line +262 set_billing_status).

Mitigation: behavioral test on Pod 8 canary post-deploy verifies row→delivery→agent-state flow before fleet roll. guard_contracts.evidence: HOT_RELOAD_FIELDS allowlist on agent side acts as explicit field-allowlist parser (string match against const &[&str]) — parser-not-regex. NON_RELOAD_FIELDS allowlist enforces structural rejection of port/ws_url/pod_number/pod_id (rejected at parse with warn). Unknown fields warn+ignore (graceful version skew) — explicit contract not implicit serde-decode-failure. PR #54 extends HOT_RELOAD_FIELDS with 'billing_paused' — single point of contract update.
